title: Combat, buffs & recovery
summary: Casting, lasting buffs and getting back into the world.
body:
AA testing candidate: More earned AA options for all classes are prepared, with native effects and finite cooldowns. These additions are not deployed or balance-approved. See the candidate scope.

Live testing: Direct Spell Damage, ordinary DoT ticks, heroic INT/WIS, pet healing and held-class melee effects have changed. Update through the launcher before testing. Spell-rank choice, mana sustain and burst balance still need player checks.

Lasting blessings and temporary abilities

Ordinary beneficial blessings on you and your owned pets persist without timer upkeep. Temporary AA effects, including Killing Spree and related triggered buffs, disciplines and short-duration song-window effects retain their timers. Death, dispels, replacement, stacking rules, charges and aura range still matter. Debuffs and hostile NPC buffs keep their timers.

Bard songs and effect duration

Song-window effects keep their normal timers; do not assume every beneficial song is permanent. Harmful effects such as damage, charm and mez keep their normal rules. Movement-song behavior is still being checked.

Blessing effects that survive reconnects

Repairs restore saved buff effects after login and stop permanent blessings expiring on the next tick. You should not need another hail or payment; player retesting continues.

Instant damage-over-time casts

Your damage-over-time spells cast instantly, while keeping mana costs, target and resistance checks, and reuse limits. Direct-damage spells keep their normal cast times.

Melee attacks during casting

Main-hand and offhand autoattacks can continue while you cast. Range, stuns, fear, and other control effects still apply.

Keep your belongings after death

Return to your bind point with equipment, inventory, and money. You still lose beneficial buffs; other death rules are unchanged.

Throw Stone and Spell Damage

Throw Stone now adds effective Spell Damage directly. At 250 Spell Damage, it deals 251 ordinary damage before other modifiers. Encounter balance remains under testing.

Spell gems after death

Memorized spell gems now persist through normal death. Death and reconnect testing is still ongoing.

Heal yourself while keeping an enemy targeted

Ordinary heals cast on your own permanent pet heal that pet. With an enemy or another ordinary NPC selected, eligible heals still redirect to you while retaining your target. Select another player to heal them. Pet-only and other specialized spells retain their target rules.

Food and drink are optional

Hunger and thirst no longer penalize recovery, and ordinary food/drink consumption no longer removes those items. Optional food bonuses, crafting ingredients and alcohol keep their own uses. Sell All preserves food, drink and spell supplies.

No EXP loss on normal death

Normal death keeps your EXP, level and AA progress intact. Buff loss and the other death rules remain. Previous losses are not refunded, and old corpses retain their recorded resurrection recovery. Sacrifice has its own explicit EXP cost and is unchanged.

Independent basic Monk attacks

When you hold Monk, Kick, Round Kick, Tiger Claw, Eagle Strike, Dragon Punch (Tail Rake for Iksar) and Flying Kick each have their own cooldown. Using one does not lock the others. Each attack still requires its normal level, skill, valid target and range, and keeps its own reuse, haste and earned AA adjustments. Update through launcher Play for matching buttons and readiness. Combat frequency and multiclass balance remain under live testing.

Cooldown duration repairs

Reuse reductions no longer create extremely long lockouts on item clicks, Mend, Bash, Frenzy and linked spells. Fully reduced cooldowns stay ready instead of restarting old timers on affected skills and AA completion paths. Ordinary reuse and effects that intentionally add time remain. Shared spell and discipline content groups, generic basic attacks, and Begging/Pick Pockets remain under investigation. This live update does not clear existing saved timers.

Independent AA cooldowns

Different activated AA families now keep separate cooldowns. Using Rampage should leave Purify Body, Mass Group Buff, Escape and Ancient Attunement ready when they have no cooldown of their own. Ranks of the same AA still share reuse. Item clicks and disciplines also no longer collide with unrelated timer types.

Existing saved waits keep their original expiry, so a timer inherited before the update can remain until it expires. Reconnect before testing. Items and spells with an explicit shared group still share reuse; the remaining shared skill and content groups are under review. Live gameplay checks continue.

Spell Damage and heroic attributes

Eligible player and permanent-pet direct damage and procs add effective Spell Damage once. Each ordinary DoT tick adds half that value, rounded down; duration does not divide this addition. Applicable critical, focus, resistance and spell restrictions still matter. Clients gain 0.1% per heroic INT on direct damage and per heroic WIS on direct healing before final caps. DoTs and HoTs do not gain the heroic multiplier. Healing Amount and HoT distribution retain their previous formulas; Bard rune songs do not gain the added Healing Amount rune bonus.

Held-class melee and shield builds

Reviewed Shield Specialist, Holy Shield, Way of Steel, Healing Light, Blessing of Life and Rage of Rallos effects follow the appropriate held classes and earned ranks. The six Monk attacks participate while keeping their skill requirements. Heroic Strength improves player weapon hits; it does not multiply pet attacks, spells, runes or Monk special attacks. Native runes replace or refresh instead of accumulating.

Separate Rabid Bear effects

The Shaman AA grants separate permanent Rabid Bear benefit and Illusion: Rabid Bear effects. Removing either leaves the other. Death, dispels and ordinary effect rules still apply.
